nodes.description: mapping(address => uint256) private _balances; stores token balances of every account
mapping(address => mapping(address => uint256)) private _allowances; nested approval allowances
uint256 private _totalSupply of the ERC20 token
string private _name; token name set once in the ERC20 constructor
string private _symbol; token symbol set once in the ERC20 constructor
string private _version in GeneratorCopyright, set in its constructor
string private constant _GENERATOR holding the generator URL
constructor(string name_, string symbol_) of ERC20; writes _name and _symbol
name() public view returns _name
symbol() public view returns _symbol
decimals() public view virtual returns 18
totalSupply() public view returns _totalSupply
balanceOf(address account) public view returns _balances[account]
transfer(address recipient, uint256 amount) public; calls _transfer(_msgSender(), recipient, amount)
allowance(address owner, address spender) public view returns _allowances[owner][spender]
approve(address spender, uint256 amount) public; calls _approve(_msgSender(), spender, amount)
transferFrom(address sender, address recipient, uint256 amount) public; moves tokens and decrements allowance
increaseAllowance(address spender, uint256 addedValue) public; adds to current allowance
decreaseAllowance(address spender, uint256 subtractedValue) public; subtracts from current allowance
_transfer(address sender, address recipient, uint256 amount) internal virtual; core balance mutation routine
_mint(address account, uint256 amount) internal virtual; increases total supply and balance
_burn(address account, uint256 amount) internal virtual; decreases balance and total supply
_approve(address owner, address spender, uint256 amount) internal virtual; writes _allowances
_beforeTokenTransfer(address from, address to, uint256 amount) internal virtual empty hook (overridable callback)
ServicePayer constructor(address payable receiver, string serviceName) payable; performs external IPayable(receiver).pay{value: msg.value}(serviceName) call
GeneratorCopyright constructor(string version_) sets _version
generator() public pure returns _GENERATOR
version() public view returns _version
SimpleERC20 constructor(name_, symbol_, initialBalance_, feeReceiver_) payable; requires supply > 0 and mints to _msgSender()
msg.sender accessed through Context._msgSender(); attacker-controlled caller address
_balances[recipient] += amount in _transfer; unchecked balance credit arithmetic
_totalSupply += amount in _mint; total supply increase arithmetic
_totalSupply -= amount in _burn; total supply decrease arithmetic
_allowances[_msgSender()][spender] + addedValue in increaseAllowance; allowance addition arithmetic
currentAllowance - amount in transferFrom; allowance subtraction arithmetic guarded by require
currentAllowance - subtractedValue in decreaseAllowance; allowance subtraction arithmetic guarded by require
IPayable(receiver).pay{value: msg.value}(serviceName) external payable call in ServicePayer constructor
string name_ parameter of the ERC20 constructor
string symbol_ parameter of the ERC20 constructor
address account parameter of balanceOf
address recipient parameter of transfer
uint256 amount parameter of transfer
address spender parameter of approve
address sender parameter of transferFrom
uint256 currentAllowance local variable read from _allowances in transferFrom
uint256 addedValue parameter of increaseAllowance
uint256 subtractedValue parameter of decreaseAllowance
uint256 senderBalance local variable read from _balances in _transfer
uint256 accountBalance local variable read from _balances in _burn
uint256 initialBalance_ parameter of the SimpleERC20 constructor
address payable feeReceiver_ parameter of the SimpleERC20 constructor
string serviceName parameter of the ServicePayer constructor
address payable receiver parameter of the ServicePayer constructor

edges.reason: transfer forwards msg.sender (via _msgSender()) as the sender whose balance is debited, so the caller identity controls the fund movement
transferFrom reads msg.sender as the spender of the allowance and as the address debited in _approve
increaseAllowance uses msg.sender as allowance owner
decreaseAllowance uses msg.sender as allowance owner
SimpleERC20 constructor mints the whole initial balance to msg.sender, giving the deployer/caller control of supply
name_ parameter is written into the _name state variable by the ERC20 constructor
symbol_ parameter is written into the _symbol state variable by the ERC20 constructor
account parameter indexes the _balances mapping in balanceOf
recipient parameter is forwarded to _transfer as the credit target
amount parameter is forwarded to _transfer as the value moved
spender parameter is forwarded to _approve as the allowance beneficiary
sender parameter is used as the debited account and allowance owner in transferFrom
currentAllowance local is read and then reduced by amount inside transferFrom
addedValue parameter is added to the stored allowance in increaseAllowance
subtractedValue parameter is subtracted from the stored allowance in decreaseAllowance
senderBalance local is read from _balances and used to debit the sender in _transfer
accountBalance local is read from _balances and used to debit the account in _burn
initialBalance_ parameter is the amount minted and checked to be > 0 in the SimpleERC20 constructor
feeReceiver_ parameter is forwarded to ServicePayer and used as the external pay target
serviceName parameter is forwarded to the external IPayable.pay call
receiver parameter is the address of the external IPayable.pay call
ERC20 constructor assigns name_ into _name
ERC20 constructor assigns symbol_ into _symbol
name() returns the _name state variable
symbol() returns the _symbol state variable
totalSupply() returns the _totalSupply state variable
balanceOf() reads the _balances mapping
allowance() reads the _allowances nested mapping
generator() returns the constant _GENERATOR state variable
version() returns the _version state variable
GeneratorCopyright constructor assigns version_ into _version
_transfer writes the debited and credited entries of the _balances mapping
_mint increases the _totalSupply state variable
_mint credits the recipient entry of _balances
_burn decreases the _totalSupply state variable
_burn debits the account entry of _balances
_approve writes the _allowances nested mapping
transferFrom reads and rewrites the caller's allowance entry
increaseAllowance updates the _allowances entry of the caller
decreaseAllowance reads and updates the _allowances entry of the caller
transfer delegates the actual token movement to the internal _transfer routine
approve delegates the allowance write to the internal _approve routine
transferFrom first invokes _transfer to move the tokens
transferFrom then invokes _approve to reduce the spent allowance
increaseAllowance calls _approve with the summed allowance
decreaseAllowance calls _approve with the reduced allowance
SimpleERC20 constructor calls _mint to create the initial supply
ServicePayer constructor performs an external payable call to an arbitrary receiver supplied at deployment, enabling reentrant control flow before state is settled
_transfer executes the _balances[recipient] += amount credit arithmetic
_mint executes the _totalSupply += amount arithmetic
_burn executes the _totalSupply -= amount arithmetic
increaseAllowance executes the allowance + addedValue arithmetic
transferFrom executes currentAllowance - amount arithmetic
decreaseAllowance executes currentAllowance - subtractedValue arithmetic
_transfer invokes the overridable _beforeTokenTransfer hook before mutating balances
_mint invokes the overridable _beforeTokenTransfer hook before minting
_burn invokes the overridable _beforeTokenTransfer hook before burning

normalization_plan.reason: The name_ parameter only exists to seed the _name state variable inside the ERC20 constructor and has no independent security meaning
The symbol_ parameter only exists to seed the _symbol state variable inside the ERC20 constructor
The account parameter is a pure lookup key used only by balanceOf
The recipient parameter is a pass-through argument of transfer and carries no standalone semantics
The amount parameter is a pass-through value of transfer and carries no standalone semantics
The spender parameter is a pass-through argument of approve
The sender parameter is only meaningful as part of transferFrom's allowance and balance logic
currentAllowance is a short-lived temporary read/write inside transferFrom
addedValue exists solely as the increment operand of increaseAllowance
subtractedValue exists solely as the decrement operand of decreaseAllowance
senderBalance is a temporary cache of _balances[sender] inside _transfer
accountBalance is a temporary cache of _balances[account] inside _burn
initialBalance_ is only used for the zero-supply check and the initial mint in the SimpleERC20 constructor
feeReceiver_ is only forwarded to ServicePayer during construction of SimpleERC20
serviceName is only forwarded to the external pay call performed by the ServicePayer constructor
receiver is the external call target consumed only by the ServicePayer constructor
